Compute the data table

Source: R/compute_data_table.R
compute_data_table.Rd

Checks that the object is normalized and returns it. The data table, the tidy (long) version of the normalized counts used by compute_metrics, plot_boxplot, plot_trend, filter_by_slope and other functions, is no longer stored in the object: it is computed from the object when needed (see get_data_table), so it always follows the counts, the annotation, the sample table and the normalization. This function is kept so that existing code works; it is not needed any more.

Usage

compute_data_table(screenR_Object)

Arguments

screenR_Object

The ScreenR object obtained using create_screenr_object, normalized with normalize_data.

Value

The ScreenR object. It is an error if it is not normalized.

See also

normalize_data, get_data_table

Examples

object <- get0("object", envir = asNamespace("ScreenR"))
object <- normalize_data(object)
object <- compute_data_table(object)
head(get_data_table(object))
#> ScreenR normalized data table: 74480 rows, 9 columns
#> # A tibble: 6 × 9
#>   Barcode Gene     Sample     Frequency Sequence Library Gene_ID Day   Treatment
#>   <fct>   <chr>    <fct>          <dbl> <lgl>    <lgl>   <lgl>   <chr> <chr>

#> 2 10208   Gene_380 T2              437. NA       NA      NA      T2    T2
